aerospikeAction: Nested rooms/rates traversal, resolved server-side — no client-side loop over the record
index: hotel-loc-idx (or hotel-locality-idx) — path expression is a filter layered on top, not itself indexed
notes: Deliberately coarse: this counts matching (room, rate, day) entries across the whole record, so it can't express "one room covers all four nights" by itself — see docs/design.md's 'Deliberately not indexed' table for why a collection index on available days would be wrong (day values repeat across rooms/rates). Per-room coverage for the property-detail projection is the finer per-room count: $.rooms.{roomId}.rates..available.*[?(@ >= {checkIn} and @ <= {checkOut})].count() == {nights}.
